summary: StudentPrerequisites provides a detailed model of prerequisite requirements for students, covering immunization, medical, safety, confidentiality, and respiratory mask compliance tracking. It enables search, validation, and update workflows for these requirements.
purpose: To track, validate, and update student medical, immunization, safety, and confidentiality prerequisites for placement and compliance.

workflows.name: StudentDetailsPrerequisitesSearch
steps: Query prerequisites for a student via StudentID and StaffID
Return field-level records for compliance tracking

workflows.name: StudentDetailsConfidentialityUpdate
steps: Update confidentiality form status and notes

business_rules: ConsentProgramID is mandatory when updating Confidentiality
ConsentObtainedDate cannot be empty or invalid
Medical/Immunization dates must not exceed maximum allowed years in the future
Fit Test Date required if Mask Size is specified
validations: Validate dates for Fit Test, Expiry, Immunization, Medical, and Confidentiality
Validate year ranges for diseases (Measles, Mumps, Varicella, Rubella)
Expiry date must be on or after completed date
calculations: Expiry date calculation for Tetanus and N95 Mask (e.g., add years to admin date)
conditions: If OccHealthReqMetStatusCodeID is 0, ImmunReqMetDate is set to NullDate
If N95MaskFitTestDate is Null and Mask Size is specified, error is triggered
system_behavior: Display errors for invalid field values via Sess.Messages
exceptions: Errors for dates more than allowed years in the future
Errors if required fields are missing
content_gaps: Some fields referenced (e.g., StaffID, Codes) have implicit or external definitions not fully detailed in retrieved content
Screen/form UI details are not included in this analysis
